final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT a.player_id AS pid, p.death_country AS dc, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS d FROM appearances a JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.death_country <> '' GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(d) AS m FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.pid, s1.dc, s1.d, s1.d - s2.m AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.m IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.d > s2.m) SELECT SUM(d), AVG(diff) FROM s3
